snippet.title: Drill Space | Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Drill Space is an upcoming rogue-lite survival mining game where gravity shapes your journey. Explore a vibrant, randomly generated solar system, mine for resources, upgrade your ship, and defend against alien invasions.🚀

🔗Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530060/Drill_Space/
🔗Discord: https://discord.com/invite/p8uvpnwyWV
